name: ch341_oled
description: OLED display over a CH341A USB adapter, for x86 Volumio systems with no I2C bus
author: foonerd

volumio_info.details: Drives an I2C OLED panel through a WCH CH341A USB adapter. Intended for x86 systems with no usable I2C bus. Uses a userspace transport, so there is no kernel module to rebuild and nothing that breaks on a system update.
